title: fix(app-shell,i18n): the keyboard-shortcuts dialog lists only shortcuts a mounted handler advertises (objectui#11674)
body:
Fixes #11674

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

The claim wrote `Clause-②: no`, with the rule that it becomes `no (narrowing)` if published `console.shortcuts.*` locale keys retire. Seven do, so the line reads `no (narrowing)`. No accept set widens, and `@object-ui/app-shell` exports nothing new.

## What was wrong (measured on `origin/main` at `c3623eb`)

The dialog was a static list, kept apart from every key handler. Every row, by the handler it had:

| Old row | Handler on `main` | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `⌘K` Open command palette | `CommandPaletteProvider` keydown (`k` with ⌘ or Ctrl) | wired |
| `?` Show keyboard shortcuts | the dialog's own keydown | wired |
| `Esc` Close dialog / panel | Radix dismiss, on every `Dialog` and `Sheet` | wired |
| `B` Toggle sidebar | the `SidebarProvider` listener (synced Shadcn primitive) answers `b` with ⌘ or Ctrl only. A bare `B` does nothing | wrong chord |
| `⌘/` Focus search | none | dead |
| `N` Create new record | none. `useCrudShortcuts` / `useKeyboardShortcuts` have no caller outside their module | dead |
| `R` Refresh data | none. The only `r` listener is the approvals inbox's reject key, on that page only | dead |
| `⌘E` Edit selected record | none | dead |
| `⌘⇧O` New chat, `⌘⇧S` Toggle conversations list | `AiChatPage` only (`matchAiChatShortcut`). The dialog mounts in `AppContent` (`/apps/...`) and `/ai` is not under it, so neither handler is mounted where the rows were shown | not wired where listed |
| `⌘D` Toggle dark mode | none | dead |

The card named five of these. The order asked for every row to be measured, which added `R` and the AI pair.

## What changed

- **`packages/app-shell/src/chrome/advertisedShortcuts.ts` (new).** A small module store, the same shape as `assistantBus`. The code that owns a handler calls `useAdvertiseShortcut(descriptor, enabled?)` beside it, so the shortcut is advertised while the handler is mounted. `useAdvertisedShortcuts()` reads the current set. A descriptor is `{ id, group, chord, label }`. The keycaps come from the chord (`shortcutKeycaps`), and `label` is a literal `t('…')` call so the i18n gates read the key (see the probe below).
- **`KeyboardShortcutsDialog`** has no list of its own any more. It renders the advertised shortcuts, grouped (`general`, `navigation`, `aiChat`) and sorted by their text, and each row carries `data-shortcut-id`. It advertises its own `?`, and `Esc` (Radix's dismiss) beside the `Dialog` that `Esc` closes.
- **`CommandPaletteProvider`** advertises `⌘K` beside its keydown handler.
- **`ConsoleLayout`'s inner component**, which sits inside `SidebarProvider`, advertises `⌘B`. The listener belongs to the primitive. `packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx` was read and not edited.
- **`AiChatPage`** advertises `⌘⇧O` and `⌘⇧S` beside the listener that calls `matchAiChatShortcut`. So they are listed only where that page is mounted, and today the dialog is not mounted there.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`.** Seven keys were read only by the dead rows, and they are removed from all ten packs: `console.shortcuts.focusSearch`, `createRecord`, `refreshData`, `editRecord`, `toggleDarkMode`, `groups.dataViews`, `groups.preferences`. Two i18n test comments cited `toggleDarkMode` as an example of ё, and they are reworded. One of them also carried a stale ё count, which is dropped, not re-counted.
- The app-shell README gains a "Keyboard-shortcuts dialog" section. The changeset is `.changeset/11674-shortcuts-dialog-wired-only.md`, `minor` for both packages, with the key removal spelled out as BREAKING at `minor` under the repo's version policy.

Inside an app, the dialog now lists `⌘K`, `?`, `Esc` and `⌘B`.

Landing point: the order expected the static list in `KeyboardShortcutsDialog.tsx`. That file is where the list was. The fix also touches three files that register handlers, and only to advertise them, as the claim's file surface allows.

## The pin

`packages/app-shell/src/chrome/KeyboardShortcutsDialog.wiredOnly-11674.test.tsx`:

- **Every listed row fires.** The test mounts the dialog where `AppContent` mounts it: inside the real `ConsoleLayout`, with the real `AppShell`, `SidebarProvider` and `CommandPaletteProvider`. It opens the dialog with `?shortcuts=1`. For each row it fires the chord that the row's own advertisement declares, once with ⌘ and once with Ctrl, each on a fresh mount, and checks the real handler's effect: the palette opens, the dialog opens, the dialog closes, the sidebar collapses. The rows must equal the advertisements, keycaps included, and must equal the probe table's keys. So a listed row that nothing can fire fails, and the loop cannot pass by running nothing.
- **The list is derived.** A row is listed while its advertiser is mounted and leaves when the advertiser unmounts.
- **The AI page's chords are the ones its real matcher answers.** `matchAiChatShortcut` returns the right action for both chords.
- **Control.** A bare `b`, the old row, does not toggle the sidebar.

## Ablations (one-off, run from committed HEAD `05c1f48`, restore proved by blob hash)

- **The defect's own shape.** The sidebar's advertisement was set back to a bare `b` (`chord: { key: 'b' }`) with `ablation-replace` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `de7e99c048be` → `93c37705f9e4`). The pin went red, `Tests 1 failed | 4 passed (5)`, at the sidebar probe: `data-sidebar-open` stayed `"true"`. Restored: blob == HEAD `de7e99c048be`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **The old static dialog.** `KeyboardShortcutsDialog.tsx` was swapped for its `c3623eb` bytes (`createRecord` marker 1, `useAdvertiseShortcut` 0, blob `ad882b0dc950`). The test went red, `Tests 2 failed | 3 passed (5)`: the pin and the derivation case. Restored: blob == HEAD `f766b2845931`.
- **The i18n gate reads the descriptor labels.** `t('console.shortcuts.toggleSidebar')` in the sidebar descriptor was renamed to a key no pack has. `check:i18n-keys` exited 1 with `[missing-key] console.shortcuts.toggleSidebarProbe` at `ConsoleLayout.tsx`. Restored: blob == HEAD.

## Gates (objectui's own; derived by hand from `package.json` and `.github/workflows/`)

All at HEAD `05c1f48`. Each exit code was captured before any pipe.

| `eslint` over the 6 changed app-shell files, `--format json` | 0 | 0 errors. 38 warnings, against 36 on the 4 modified files at `c3623eb` (read through `--stdin`). The +2 are `react-refresh/only-export-components` on the two exported AI-page descriptors |

| `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs` (18 source files, 2 packages, 1 changeset), `check-changeset-fixed.mjs` | 0 each | |
| `check:readme-exports` | NOT MEASURED | PREREQUISITE: it needs every package's `dist`. No export moved, and the new README section has no fenced import |
| `check:eager-locale-catalogues` | NOT MEASURED | PREREQUISITE: it needs `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json` |

Why the lint narrowing holds:

- The population is each package's `lint` script, `eslint .`.
- `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so no lint is type-aware.
- No rule under `eslint-rules/` reads another file.

So this diff cannot change the verdict on a file it did not touch. The full `pnpm test`, repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the `apps/console` suites are left to CI.

Declared narrowing: the verify lock was held for about 26 minutes by a sibling's full-suite run. During that time the single pin file, and the ablations, ran without the lock (`--maxWorkers=1`). The final runs in the table above went through the lock.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- **`⌘⇧I`, the chat-dock toggle in `ConsoleLayout`, is wired and not advertised.** A row needs a new `console.shortcuts.*` key in ten packs. That is a widening, outside this claim's `Clause-②: no`. With this mechanism it costs one `useAdvertiseShortcut` call and the key. Carrier: none.
- **Page-scoped shortcuts are wired and not advertised:** QuickFind `⌘⇧M`, the resource editor's `⌘S` / `⌘\` / `Esc`, the approvals inbox's list keys, the performance panel's `Ctrl+Shift+P`, and `useDebugMode`'s `Ctrl+Shift+D`. Once advertised, each would be listed only on its own page. This PR reads "lists exactly the shortcuts that are wired" as "lists no shortcut that is not wired", plus the chrome layer that owned the old list.
- **`useKeyboardShortcuts`, `useCrudShortcuts` and `getShortcutDescriptions` in `@object-ui/react` are published and have zero callers.** This is dead code, and wiring it is not this card's question.
- **The keycaps draw `⌘` on every platform**, as before. Every advertised handler also accepts Ctrl.
- **The dialog is not mounted on `/ai`**, and the `/ai` header hides the Help-menu entry. So the AI pair is listed nowhere today. That is correct under the rule, and it is unchanged.
- **Not measured, inferred from source:** the `SidebarProvider` listener does not skip editable targets, so `⌘B` inside a rich-text field may toggle the sidebar.
